name: Chubu Steel Plate Co Ltd
summary: Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd., operating with its subsidiaries, is a Japanese firm primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of steel plates. Its operations are structured across four main divisions: Steel Related Business, Rental Business, Logistics Business, and Engineering Business. The Steel Related Business segment offers an extensive range of steel products, including various steel plates designed for laser cutting, those resistant to hydrochloric and sulfuric acids, high-tensile strength plates, and structural plates for buildings. This division also supplies rolled steels suitable for general, welded, and structural applications, alongside hot-rolled atmospheric corrosion-resistant steels for welded structures. Furthermore, it produces carbon and molybdenum alloy steels for boilers and pressure vessels, as well as both carbon and low-alloyed steels for machine structural components. The Rental Business focuses on providing rental services for grease-filters in commercial kitchens, complemented by duct and grease trap cleaning services, and solutions for advertising signboards. Within the Logistics Business, the company handles transportation, cargo management, and the secure storage of dangerous goods. Lastly, the Engineering Business division is responsible for designing and constructing plants, with a particular focus on steel-related equipment, and also delivers essential equipment maintenance services. The diverse products from Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd. are widely utilized in numerous applications, such as construction machinery, industrial equipment, machine tools and their parts, factory installations, specialized industrial vehicles, infrastructure development, general construction, and the transport sector. The company, established in 1950, maintains its corporate headquarters in Nagoya, Japan.
